note: Microsoft first-party agents. The original 14 were extracted from the PRO-ENG facilitator prototype deck and revalidated against current public Microsoft Learn documentation. An additional 8 (source_slide: 3) were added by directly researching Microsoft Learn to close a gap found while cross-checking against https://microsoft.github.io/copilot-studio-estimator/'s product catalog: Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, Project Operations, and Business Central were entirely absent from this catalog. Two estimator-listed agents (Customer Assist Agent, and the Contact Center variant of Customer Knowledge Management Agent) were deliberately excluded because they lack a dedicated Microsoft Learn page distinct from either a multi-agent overview or an existing catalog entry.
guidance: Use this catalog to understand the current Microsoft first-party capability before deciding whether any custom agent work is needed.
currency_policy: This catalog records only current publicly documented product names, capabilities, lifecycle labels, and links as of snapshot_date. Lifecycle is published only when the current Microsoft Learn page explicitly states it. The source deck status is retained separately as provenance and is not presented as current lifecycle evidence. Roadmap, pre-announcements, expected mergers, and expected renames are excluded.

agents.name: Sales Qualification Agent
agents.deck_description: Researches leads, evaluates fit, autonomous outreach
agents.description: Automates lead research and, when configured for research and engage mode, lead outreach and follow-up.
use_cases: Research selected leads and assess their fit against a target customer profile
Generate an initial outreach email for matching leads in research-only mode
Send outreach and follow-up messages in research and engage mode
Evaluate purchase intent and BANT criteria before handing promising leads to sellers

agents.name: Sales Opportunity Agent
agents.deck_description: Continuous opportunity research, risk & stakeholder intelligence
agents.description: Researches open opportunities and provides deal prioritization, risk, stakeholder, competitor, and deal-health insights.
use_cases: Continuously research open opportunities using available sales context
Surface deal risks and material changes that need seller attention
Prioritize opportunities so sellers can focus on the deals that need action
Review stakeholder, competitor, and deal-health context for an opportunity

agents.name: Sales Research Agent
agents.deck_description: Natural language dialog with sales data
agents.description: Answers strategic sales questions through natural-language research over Dynamics 365 Sales data and other configured data sources.
use_cases: Explore pipeline and sales operations questions using natural language
Research Dynamics 365 Sales data together with uploaded CSV, Excel, or PDF files
Generate a research blueprint with findings, suggested next steps, and visualizations
Ask follow-up questions, change visualizations, and add data to an active analysis

agents.name: Sales Development agent
agents.deck_description: Automats sales outreach and prospect management within Microsoft Teams
agents.description: Automates sales outreach and prospect management in Microsoft Teams through an Agent 365 agent with its own identity.
use_cases: Automate personalized prospect outreach and follow-up in Microsoft Teams
Configure the agent playbook, guidelines, product knowledge, and settings through chat
Integrate Dynamics 365 for lead management and activity tracking
Review prospect status and scale a reviewed configuration across teams

agents.name: Recommended Actions agent
agents.deck_description: Prioritized seller actions based on opportunity context
agents.description: Presents prioritized recommended actions so sellers can focus on the most relevant tasks for their opportunities.
use_cases: Review a prioritized list of recommended seller actions
Use opportunity context to focus attention on the most relevant next tasks
Combine recommendations from Sales Opportunity Agent and configured custom agents
Review Data Enrichment actions alongside the prioritized recommendations

agents.name: Sales agent
agents.deck_description: Search, synthesize & act on sales data in M365 apps
agents.description: Provides a natural-language interface in Microsoft 365 Copilot for searching, synthesizing, and acting on connected sales data.
use_cases: Query connected Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce CRM data using natural language
Synthesize CRM records with eligible email, Teams meeting, and Teams message context
Prepare account and opportunity summaries before customer engagement
Draft follow-up communications and actions from the available sales context

agents.name: AI-powered Data Enrichment for opportunities
agents.deck_description: Enriches opportunity data from email interactions
agents.description: Analyzes recent email and Teams meeting context to suggest or make configured updates to opportunity records.
use_cases: Analyze recent email exchanges and Teams meeting context for selected opportunities
Identify missing or outdated opportunity information
Suggest or automatically make configured opportunity-field updates
Associate relevant email conversations with the opportunity record

agents.name: Case Management Agent
agents.deck_description: Automates case lifecycle - create, update, resolve, close
agents.description: Creates cases from supported conversations and updates configured case fields from conversation or email context.
use_cases: Create cases from chat, digital messaging, and incoming voice conversations
Update configured case fields when a conversation reaches wrap-up
Update configured fields from incoming emails associated with a case
Populate suggested field values when a representative creates a case manually

agents.name: Customer Knowledge Management Agent
agents.deck_description: Extracts knowledge from closed cases, fills gaps
agents.description: Creates knowledge articles from cases and related conversations, emails, and notes.
use_cases: Create draft knowledge articles from resolved cases and related communications
Harvest knowledge from conversations, emails, and notes associated with a case
Run knowledge harvesting in real time or through configured processing
Review generated article content before it enters the governed knowledge lifecycle

agents.name: Quality Evaluation Agent
agents.description: Uses supervisor-defined criteria and evaluation plans to score selected interactions and provide summaries and recommended actions.
use_cases: Define reusable quality criteria and scoring logic
Create evaluation plans that select which cases or conversations are assessed
Generate evaluation scores, summaries, and recommended actions
Review quality trends and outliers across evaluated interactions
capability_notes: Email evaluation is explicitly documented as Preview.

agents.name: Customer Intent Agent
agents.deck_description: Discovers intents from cases/conversations, builds intent library
agents.description: Discovers intents from historical customer interactions and manages them as an intent library for assisted and self-service experiences.
use_cases: Discover new customer intents from historical cases and conversations
Manage intents, intent groups, and optional lines of business
Provide representatives with intent-based questions and suggested solutions
Use intent context to support self-service follow-up questions and knowledge retrieval

agents.name: Customer Intent Agent for voice
agents.deck_description: Autonomous voice resolution using intent library + playbooks
agents.description: Uses the Customer Intent Agent intent library to support intent-driven voice self-service and escalation.
use_cases: Detect customer intent during an inbound voice interaction
Ask intent-specific follow-up questions and provide a solution from configured resources
Escalate the conversation to a representative when self-service cannot resolve it
Connect an intent-enabled voice agent to a queue or workstream

agents.name: Quality Management Agent
agents.description: Provides a unified set of quality-management capabilities for evaluation, communication governance, and screen and call recording.
use_cases: Evaluate customer interactions against defined quality criteria
Apply governance policies to outgoing customer communications
Capture screen and call context for quality review
Support coaching, compliance, and continuous service improvement
agents.configure_note: Quality Management Agent is configured through its individual quality evaluation, governance, and recording capabilities, which are linked from the overview.

agents.name: Quality Assurance Agent
agents.description: Monitors live contact-center conversations, alerts supervisors to quality issues, and supports real-time coaching.
use_cases: Monitor active customer conversations for quality issues
Alert supervisors when a quality indicator or guardrail needs attention
Run real-time or conversation-close evaluation plans
Send coaching nudges to representatives during active conversations

agents.name: Procurement Agent
agents.description: Automates supplier email communications and evaluates the downstream impact of supplier-driven changes to purchase orders and supply commitments.
use_cases: Classify and analyze inbound supplier emails about purchase order confirmations and change requests
Draft or send outbound reminder and follow-up emails to suppliers on the purchaser's behalf
Evaluate how a supplier's requested change would affect inventory, production, and customer commitments
Let purchasers quickly confirm and apply supplier-driven changes instead of re-entering them manually

agents.name: Account Reconciliation Agent
agents.description: Continuously compares general ledger transactions against subsidiary ledgers, flags discrepancies, and recommends corrective actions to keep the books reconciled between close periods.
use_cases: Continuously compare general ledger and subsidiary ledger transactions across the accounting period
Flag discrepancies such as unmatched entries or amount mismatches as soon as they occur
Review AI-suggested corrective actions before applying them to a reconciliation exception
See a dashboard of open and closed reconciliation exceptions instead of waiting for period-end

agents.name: Expense Agent
agents.description: Extracts data from submitted receipts and assembles expense lines and reports for approval, reducing manual expense entry for project teams.
use_cases: Submit a receipt by uploading it in the app or forwarding it to a monitored mailbox
Let the agent extract merchant, amount, currency, and date from the receipt automatically
Group extracted expenses into a report by project or trip for review
Apply configured policy rules before an expense report reaches an approver

agents.name: Expense Agent
agents.description: Lets any employee submit a receipt by web app or email, then extracts, categorizes, and assembles the data into an expense report inside Business Central.
use_cases: Submit a receipt through the dedicated expense web app or by forwarding it to a shared mailbox, with no Business Central license required
Let the agent extract and categorize receipt data automatically
Review and submit the resulting expense report for approval
Keep all financial data, audit trails, and posting logic inside Business Central's existing rules

agents.name: Approvals Agent
agents.description: Reviews submitted time, expense, and material entries against uploaded policy documents and classifies each as ready for approval or needing review.
use_cases: Upload policy documents at the organization or project level for the agent to check entries against
Automatically classify incoming time, expense, and material entries as ready for approval or needing review
Optionally let the agent auto-approve entries that clearly match policy
Reduce the manual review load on project managers approving routine entries

agents.name: Time Entry Agent
agents.description: Drafts weekly time entries for project team members from assignments, booked capacity, or prior entries, then reminds them to review and submit.
use_cases: Generate draft time entries at the start of each week from project assignments or booked capacity
Notify team members in Microsoft Teams about their draft entries
Review, modify, and submit draft entries from Teams or the Project Operations web app
Receive a reminder near week's end if any time entries are still missing

agents.name: Sales Order Agent
agents.description: Reads customer sales requests from a monitored mailbox, checks inventory, and prepares a sales quote or order for review before it's sent.
use_cases: Monitor a designated mailbox for incoming customer sales requests
Clarify missing order details with the customer through a multi-turn email conversation
Check inventory availability and prepare a sales quote or order as a PDF
Let an authorized user review and approve the draft before it is converted to an order

agents.name: Payables Agent
agents.description: Monitors a mailbox for vendor invoices, extracts the data with AI, and prepares a draft purchase invoice for a supervisor to review before posting.
use_cases: Monitor a designated mailbox for incoming vendor invoice emails with PDF attachments
Extract invoice details automatically using AI-based document analysis
Match the invoice to an existing vendor or flag it for supervisor input
Review the draft purchase invoice before it is finalized and posted
